pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On the station open Service → Pairing → Pair a new source, then enter the 8-digit code shown there.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: This station no longer recognises Home Assistant — pair again. On the station open Service → Pairing → Pair a new source, then enter the 8-digit code shown there.

error.invalid_host: That is not a host name or IP address. Enter just the address (for example 10.0.0.4 or studio.local) — no http:// and no :port; the port goes in its own field.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the station. Is 'Accept sources from the LAN' turned on in its Pairing screen?
error.window_closed: The station's pairing window is not open. Open Pairing on the station and try again.
error.window_exhausted: That code was not accepted, and three wrong codes have closed the station's pairing window. On the station open Service → Pairing → Pair a new source again for a fresh code.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while pairing with the station. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.reauth_successful: Paired again. Home Assistant can raise alerts on this station once more.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the station at the address it announced. Is 'Accept sources from the LAN' still turned on in its Pairing screen?
abort.unsupported_version: This station announced itself in a way this version of the integration does not understand. Update the AlertRoster integration, or add the station by host and port instead.
abort.already_in_progress: This station is already being set up.

raise.name: Raise an alert
raise.description: Raises an alert on a paired AlertRoster station, which pages whoever is on it. Returns the alert, so a later Resolve can use its ID.

config_entry.name: Station
config_entry.description: Which paired station to raise the alert on. Optional when only one is paired.

title.name: Title
title.description: The one line the person answering sees first.

detail.name: Detail
detail.description: Anything more the person answering should know.

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: How hard the station should page. The station decides what each level does.

dedup_key.name: Deduplication key
dedup_key.description: Raising again with the same key while the alert is still open succeeds and returns the existing alert instead of a second one, so a retrying automation is safe. It does not update the alert: to change one, resolve it and raise a new one.

ack_timeout_seconds.name: Acknowledgement timeout
ack_timeout_seconds.description: How long the station waits for someone to answer before the alert expires. Leave empty to use the station's own default. 0 means it never expires: the station keeps paging until a person answers, and "nobody answered" will never fire for it. Use 0 when the alert should reach a phone off-site, because the station only escalates once this has run out.

resolve.name: Resolve an alert
resolve.description: Tells the station the condition cleared. Give either the alert ID or the deduplication key.

config_entry.name: Station
config_entry.description: Which paired station the alert is on. Optional when only one is paired.

alert_id.name: Alert ID
alert_id.description: The ID returned when the alert was raised.

dedup_key.name: Deduplication key
dedup_key.description: The key the alert was raised with, if you did not keep its ID.
